name: wildcat-student-app
description: Native iOS + Android wrapper of the Wildcat student portal, with NDEF NFC read/write, native Google sign-in, camera and push.

scripts.prepare-native: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync && npm run configure:ios
scripts.run:ios: npm run prepare-native && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run prepare-native && npx cap run android
